_about: Issuer family -> Common SUBJ, for the exhibit subject fill (kb/_exhibit_subject_fill.py, rung c and the conflict hold). Only a family whose credentials all sit in one discipline belongs here. A family is recognized from a title's certification links (kb/exhibit_cert_links.json certs[].family) or from its issuer or MAP titles matching one of `issuer_patterns` (case-insensitive). Every subject must be a Common SUBJ the Common Subjects Reference holds (kb/discipline_canonical_subj4.json); the fill skips and lists one that is not. Small on purpose, so the planned issuer registry can absorb it.
